info.title: AniResQ API
info.description: Backend API for AniResQ animal rescue, adoption, and lost-and-found management platform.

get.description:
Publicly visible rescue markers.
Obfuscates precise coordinates (~500m - 1km) and omits description, address, photos, and reporter info.
Filters to unresolved/active cases by default unless status is explicitly requested.

Allows shelter/NGO managers and administrators to query users and view pending role requests.
Strictly forbids VET and regular users from harvesting user directory PII.

post.description: Allows citizens to surrender or donate an animal for shelter intake review.
Allows a shelter/NGO to claim a surrendered animal for intake.
